actual: run against the code of Task 1: refusals exit with the right code but append no decision.rejected event, a duplicate and a stale answer are refused as 'not supported yet', and an amendment request is an unlisted option, so 8 of 8 tests of the response suite fail on assertions over events, exit codes and rows; the identity refusals and the withdrawal that ends a run already hold
semanticAssessment: The failures are assertions over ledger events, decision rows and exit codes after a real S-17 blocked run built through the test CLI; the command, the run and the ledger work and only the recording, duplicate, stale and amendment-request outcomes are missing. Not import or syntax errors.
